useWhen: Designing frontend component structure from scratch

workflow.description: Break UI into pieces, identify reusability, define boundaries
Map parent/child relationships, composition patterns, data flow
Define API surface, types, and default values
Create usage examples, do's and don'ts

examples.input: Design component architecture for a dashboard with cards, charts, data tables, and filters.
Build a modal component system with different sizes, with/without header, footer actions.
